spec.template: A wide establishing shot of a botanical greenhouse with glass walls and rows of green seedlings. No watering can visible. Slow camera pan. Clear neutral daylight. Realistic live-action cinematography. Stable natural motion.

Close-up of a {{prop.color}} metal watering can on a greenhouse bench beside green seedlings. The entire watering can remains visible. Slow camera push in. Clear neutral daylight. Realistic live-action cinematography. Stable natural motion.
A macro shot of water droplets on green seedling leaves in a greenhouse. No watering can visible. Stable camera. Clear neutral daylight. Realistic live-action cinematography. Stable natural motion.

Close-up of hands watering seedlings with a {{prop.color}} metal watering can in a greenhouse. The entire watering can remains clearly visible. Clear neutral daylight. Realistic live-action cinematography. Stable natural motion.

A wide upward shot of the glass roof and hanging green plants in a greenhouse. No watering can visible. Slow camera movement. Clear neutral daylight. Realistic live-action cinematography. Stable natural motion.

A {{prop.color}} metal watering can is placed on a greenhouse bench beside trays of seedlings. Close-up of hands setting it down, the full can stays visible. Clear neutral daylight. Realistic live-action cinematography. Stable natural motion.
